question: Should OpenClaw accept selectable quick-fix and full-change PR templates as the contributor-facing PR authoring contract?
rationale: The implementation is narrow, but it changes how external contributors are prompted for evidence and review context, and the linked canonical issue is marked as needing a product decision.

options.title: Approve After Current-Head Proof
options.body: Land the quick/full template split after the contributor adds a current-head screenshot or recording showing the final rendered template bodies.

options.title: Keep Default Template Only
options.body: Reject the split and keep one fallback template if maintainers prefer a single authoring path for all external PRs.

options.title: Revise Template Contract
options.body: Ask for a different quick/full template shape if maintainers want stricter evidence, risk, or AI disclosure prompts in the quick path.

recommendation.title: Approve After Current-Head Proof
recommendation.body: Land the quick/full template split after the contributor adds a current-head screenshot or recording showing the final rendered template bodies.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman has the strongest history on the PR-template structure and review-guidance surface affected by this decision.
